the crystal bending technique can be used to increase the deflection angle by a factor of 4.6 and the efficiency of one-side deflection to about 65%.
the multiple volume reflection by the different planes of a bent silicon crystal is observed for the first-time for high-energy negative pions.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an experimental method for the observation and investigation of multiple volume reflection in bent silicon crystals for high-energy negative particle beams.
the development of a new type of high-energy negative particle beam source.
a new type of crystal optics, volume reflection, which was first observed in 2005 for positive particles.

the crystal is not bent in the way that is claimed.
the results of the present study support a model for the mechanism of the crystal bending, in which the effect is due to the interaction between the beam and the crystal.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we observed multiple volume reflection by bent silicon crystals for the first time.
we observed the first multiple volume reflection for high-energy negative pions in a bent silicon single crystal.
we have observed for the first-time the multiple volume reflection by the different planes passing through a bent axis for the high energy particles.
The main takeaway from our work is that
multiple volume reflection is possible in bent silicon crystals.
multiple volume reflection by a bent crystal is an efficient way for the production of high-intensity beams.
multiple volume reflection is a very promising technique for high-energy negative hadrons.
